exercise.prompt:
Make a full page for a coding meetup.
1. A `<head>` with a `<title>`, and a `<body>` for everything else.
2. A `<header>` with an `<h1>` and a `<nav>` holding at least two links.
3. A `<main>` with a paragraph about the event.
4. A sign-up `<form>` with a `<label>`, an `<input>` with `type="email"` and a button with `type="submit"`.
5. A `<footer>` at the end.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek coding meetup ke liye poora page banao.
1. Ek `<head>` jismein `<title>` ho, aur baaki sab ke liye ek `<body>`.
2. Ek `<header>` jismein `<h1>` aur kam se kam do links wala `<nav>` ho.
3. Ek `<main>` jismein event ke baare mein paragraph ho.
4. Ek sign-up `<form>` jismein `<label>`, `type="email"` wala `<input>` aur `type="submit"` wala button ho.
5. Aakhir mein ek `<footer>`.
exercise.starterCode:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <!-- Add the head and body here -->
</html>

checks.label: The `<nav>` has at least two links
checks.labelHi: `<nav>` mein kam se kam do links hain

checks.label: The form has a button with `type="submit"`
